sloka: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यम् सुग्रीवो वानर अधिपः ।दर्शनीयतमो भूत्वा प्रीत्या उवाच राघवम् ॥४-५-८॥
transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyam sugrīvo vānara adhipaḥ ।darśanīyatamo bhūtvā prītyā uvāca rāghavam ॥4-5-8॥

translations.english: Hanuman's words took away Sugriva's great fear for Rama and filled him with cheer. This bull among monkeys gave up his natural appearance and and assuming an attractive human form spoke to Rama lovingly:
